title: release-evidence/v0 release event
description: DRAFT. One transition of D5's deployment state machine, recorded as one line of an append-only release-events.jsonl. The CURRENT state of a release is always derived by folding its events in order -- no event stores a computed state, and nothing ever rewrites a past line (corrections are new events). The transition GRAPH (prepared -> preview deployed -> preview verified -> [staging] -> production deployed -> production verified / failed / rolled_back) is deliberately NOT expressible in a single-record schema; it is enforced by the collection-level semantic checks in verify-fixtures.mjs and by the implementation, the same split every other contract in this repo uses for cross-record rules.

event_id.description: Unique within the ledger. v0 does not prescribe a derivation; an implementation SHOULD derive it deterministically from (release_id, kind, environment, occurred_at) so a re-emitted event is idempotent rather than duplicated.

kind.description: prepared = the evidence bundle was assembled and pinned (no environment yet). deployed/verified = the bundle's artifacts reached / were verified in `environment`. failed = verification or the deploy itself failed there. rolled_back = this release was withdrawn in favor of rollback_to_release_id.

environment.description: null exactly when kind=prepared (schema-enforced below): preparation is environment-less by definition, and every later event names where it happened.

actor.description: Who caused the transition. Same closed set trace/v1 uses minus `agent` -- v0 deliberately has no autonomous-agent deploy path (D5 defers automatic promotion/rollback outright).

bundle_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical (JCS) form of this release's evidence bundle. THE same-artifact invariant lives here: every event of one release_id MUST carry the same bundle_digest (collection check) -- build once, promote the same evidence everywhere. A changed tree means a new bundle means `release prepare` starts over (D5).

rollback_to_release_id.description: rolled_back only (schema-enforced below): must name a release recorded in the same ledger (collection check -- same dangling-reference rule, and same rationale, as release-observation/v0's rollback_of).

reason.description: failed only (schema-enforced below): what failed, human-readable. A failed event with no recorded reason is a fact nobody can act on later.
